fields.Fees — Published: Both official 2026–27 brochures quote annual tuition ₹7.50 lakh and a 5–8% second-year revision. A fixed two-year invoice is unavailable.

fields.Fee estimate basis:
Derived two-year non-refundable academic-fee scenario, not a confirmed invoice. Official annual ₹7.50 lakh includes ₹0.70 lakh admission fee and ₹0.25 lakh refundable security. Assume both are first-year-only and apply the stated 5–8% second-year revision to recurring ₹6.55 lakh: year 1 net ₹7.25 lakh + year 2 ₹6.55 lakh × 1.05–1.08 = ₹14.1275–14.324 lakh. Excludes ₹1,800 application fee, refundable security, annual living fee (currently ₹2.75 lakh), travel and personal expenses. The brochure does not explicitly confirm the revision base, so this calculation needs a fee letter before being treated as payable actual.
Conditional fee low ₹L: 14.1275; Conditional fee high ₹L: 14.324
